Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛻🏕️🛣️ ## Parks, Roads + Lane Wear Control park maintenance, road repair trucks, and the rate of road wear.
**调整公园维护、道路维修车辆和道路磨损速度。** 🇨🇳 **简体中文介绍见下方 ↓**
### Adjust
- **Park maintenance:** depot fleet size, work capacity, and work rate - **Road repair:** depot fleet size, work capacity, and repair rate - **Lane wear:** roads deteriorate slower or faster. Damaged roads make vehicles drive slower. 0% stops road wear, clears existing wear, recalls unneeded repair trucks - Accident response still happens normally.
Each feature is optional. **100% = normal game default.**
## Performance - **Lightweight:** no in-city UI bloat. - **Set it and forget it.** Settings apply once, then the mod sleeps. No ongoing city performance hit. - Safe to remove anytime. All vanilla, no Harmony patches > more reliable on game patch days. - Some park and road features were originally in [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows). This standalone mod keeps them separate and simple. - See the in-game Options tooltips for more details.
## Support and Feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right). No donations requested. - Feedback and PRs welcome through the GitHub and Discord links (icons on the right).
## Credits - River-Mochi — mod author - Thumbnail photo by [nps.gov Yellowstone Park Renovation](https://www.nps.gov/yell/getinvolved/planning.htm)
### Compatibility - Snowy Roads mod: Snow visuals still work at 0%, but snowplow clearing may be limited when road maintenance dispatches are reduced, suggest 5% or higher on lane wear slider.

## 🛻 公园维护、道路维修与磨损控制
自由调整公园维护、道路维修车队和道路磨损速度，让城市管理更轻松！
### 主要功能
- **公园维护：** 调整车辆数量、工作量和效率。 - **道路维修：** 调整维修车队规模、工作量和维修速度。 - **道路磨损：** 自由调整道路磨损速度。**设为 0% 可停止磨损、清除现有损坏，并召回不必要的修路车。** 事故救援照常进行。
所有功能均可独立调整，**100% = 游戏原版设置**。
### 性能与兼容性
- **轻量高效：** 修改设置后自动应用，无需持续运行，不使用 Harmony 补丁。 - **Snowy Roads：** 0% 仍可显示积雪，但除雪车可能不出动。建议尝试 **5% 或更高**，但不保证派车。 - 可以随时卸载，且无需安装 All Transit + Trucks。
👍 喜欢的话请点个赞！欢迎通过 GitHub 或 Discord 提出建议。
更多详细说明，请安装模组后查看游戏内的 **选项菜单（Options）**。
Publish.ChangeLog: - Player request filled: reduced slider from 5% limit to 0% option to allow no road wear. - Auto recalls trucks assigned to obsolete road repairs, reducing unnecessary traffic. - Accident response not affected. - Suggest setting road wear to at least 5% or more if using the Snowy Roads mod. - updated all translations for tooltips.
